notes.title: 📦 Patch Update – Reduced Game Size
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

This update optimizes AmaZoo by reducing the game's file size. Fonts and assets have been optimized to remove unnecessary data, resulting in a more lightweight build without affecting gameplay or visuals.

notes.title: Cancel Take/Throw and hotfix
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
Content Update

Cancel 'Take' and 'Throw' with the opposite mouse button.

You can now cancel 'Take' when holding left click on a box by right-clicking.
You can now cancel 'Throw' while holding right click to prepare a throw by left-clicking.


Fixed Issues

Level 05-06: Added missing wall for robots..
Robots falling on KoKo will now correctly kill her instead of walking on her head.
Fixed a specific situation where a robot could get stuck in the ground instead of being crushed.
Completely broken pots can no longer be picked up.
Fixed a bug where a box just picked up could fall on KoKo's head.
Fixed a bug preventing the key box from being affected by gravity after a level restart.
Holding 'Take' on a box that has exploded will now be canceled.

notes.title: AmaZoo - Demo Hotfix - Haloween
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173172/0720237fd1418961a134256993839286c93c993e.gif

Content Update

Strange orange packages with a sinister grin have appeared in the warehouse...
A new puzzle level that better introduces the wheeling box. Several players pointed out that stage 03-03 didn’t seem to offer any challenge or purpose... this has now been fixed.
New feature: pushing a wheeling box against another will make it start rolling too.


Fixed Issues

Fixed cases where left-clicking on the player to return wouldn’t work.

notes.title: AmaZoo - Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
Content Update

Add the stage and level numbers in-game.
Add the stage and level numbers in the pause menu.
Update gameplay: left-click on KoKo to turn her around.


Fixed Issues

Fix visual bug at certain resolutions when the screen ratio is not 16:9.
Fix visual bug where boxes are desynchronized from their actual position on the grid.
